Common pests we handle

From gophers to termites — we’ve got it covered

These are the pests we see most across Southern California. If it’s not on the list, call and ask — if it’s a pest in your home, we can help.

Gophers

Long mounds of excess soil, bare patches in the yard and chewed roots are the signs — we find the tunnels and solve the problem at the source.

Rats & Mice

Rodents transmit diseases and soil food areas. Our technicians perform a thorough inspection and identify every entry point — safely and thoroughly.

Termites

Termites feed on wood and dead plant matter in colonies. We inspect, identify the species and treat before the damage spreads.

Ants

From kitchen trails to nests in the walls — targeted ant treatment that stops the colony, not just the ants you can see.

Cockroaches

Cockroach treatment for kitchens, bathrooms and food storage areas, with a plan that fits your property.

Spiders

Spider removal and web clearing around eaves, garages and living spaces — inside and out.

Mosquitoes

Mosquito control so your yard is usable again — treatment focused on the places they breed and rest.

Ground Squirrels

Ground squirrel control for lawns and gardens, handled by technicians who know the local species.

General Pest Control

One call covers the common pests of Southern California — inspected, diagnosed and treated with your family’s safety in mind.
